public_evidence: The task explicitly requires standard-library MIME fallback for extensions with and without a leading dot.
The implementation gates mime.TypeByExtension behind extension[0] == '.'.
The green WithoutDot test does not distinguish built-in-map success from standard-library fallback.
The QueryBool documentation contradicts the required and implemented true fallback.
diagnosis: A compatibility repair narrowed the new MIME contract, while insufficiently discriminating tests allowed the narrowed implementation to appear complete.
release_condition: Prove dotted and undotted standard-library-only fallback, preserve Accepts separately, fix contradictory documentation/error ordering, and rerun full tests.
